calls.thesis: Guest Keith Kaplan (TradeSmith CEO): Guardant Health 'fantastic stock and trend for the next couple of years'; Shield blood test for colorectal cancer — revenue tripled last quarter, ACS guideline inclusion, UnitedHealthcare coverage (94M people access); $23B mkt cap, up 65% this year; earnings late Oct.
calls.bull_case: Earnings blowout late Oct; AI-driven test improves with every test run.
calls.bear_case: At all-time high after 10% pullback; crowded biotech trade.
